profile.headline: Full-Stack web developer primarily experienced in Javascript and Typescript with React. Passionate about learning and experimenting with web technologies. Additional experience with Angular, Devops, SQL, and Java.
profile.geoLocationName: Providence County, Rhode Island, United States
profile.summary: React and Typescript Full-Stack Developer. Always trying to learn something new, always trying to pass something on to the next dev.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
Seaware LMS- Learning Management System
 ● Developed for a Learning Management System based in Springboot and Angular.
 ● Product designed with support for multiple database solutions such as MSSQL, MySQL and PostGres
 ● Support for multiple web server solutions including Jboss and IIS
 ● Designed project and developer workflow to operate within airgapped environment and legacy software
 packages.
 ● Ledinitiative to modernize documentation and best practices.
 ● Built and managed virtual machines using Linux Hyper-V virtual machines.
 ● Built disconnected development environment including internal NodeJS repository, Maven repository,
 and SonarQube Code Quality Analysis Tool.
 ● Built development pipeline using GitLab runner.
 ● Upgraded and migrated Windows Servers in a disconnected environment.
 ● Implemented self-managed GitLab installation in an air-gapped development environment.
 ● Built DevOps pipeline using Windows Hyper-V, Docker, and Ubuntu Server in a disconnected
 environment.
 ● Project left with a working dev pipeline that is well-documented and maintainable by less experienced
 engineers.
 ● Mentored DevOps engineer in maintenance of the devops pipelines and servers.

 IETM Builder Project- Technical Documentation Deployment System for US Navy
 ● Designed and developed RESTful API backend for an inventory management system to generate
 mixed confidential and non-confidential dataset.
 ● System built using NodeJS, React, Loopback, Typescript, Material-UI, MariaDB.
 ● Built Database Migration Utility to upgrade cleanly from previous versions.
 ● Upgraded old repositories to Typescript to improve maintainability as project grew in scope.
 ● Built Database Denormalization Utility to organize and flatten several thousand data structures and
 relations for deployment to disconnected environments.
 ● Built DevOps pipeline using CentOS 7, CentOS 8 Stream, Docker, and KVM.
 ● Mentored Junior devs in development best practices and software architecture.
positions.insights: Skills: Front-End Development · Web Design · MySQL · JavaScript · Git · SQL · Object Oriented Design · React.js · Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) · Software Development
